description:
This tool calls the Actor "gouda_studios/website-contact-extractor" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Email extractor and contact scraper for lead gen. Give it any list of websites and get emails, phones, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok links and addresses, one deduplicated row per site. Cloudflare emails decoded, phones validated. Pay only for sites where contacts are found.

checkMx.description:
Adds a free DNS check that each email domain can receive mail. Flags typos and dead domains.
Example values: true
checkMx.title: Check email domains for MX records

defaultCountry.description:
Two-letter country code used to read local phone numbers that have no +country prefix, e.g. US, GB, DE, AU.
Example values: "US"
defaultCountry.title: Default phone country

maxPagesPerSite.description:
How many pages to read on each site, starting with the homepage and then the most likely contact pages (Contact, About, Team, Impressum, Support). You pay per site, not per page, so higher values only cost more time.
Example values: 8
maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site

proxyConfiguration.description:
Optional. Most business sites work without a proxy. Turn on Apify Proxy if many sites time out or block requests.
Example values: {"useApifyProxy":false}

apifyProxyGroups.description:
Select specific Apify Proxy groups to use (e.g., RESIDENTIAL, DATACENTER).
**DATACENTER:**
The fastest and cheapest option. It uses datacenters to change your IP address. Note that there is a chance of being blocked because of the activity of other users.

**RESIDENTIAL:**
IP addresses located in homes and offices around the world. These IPs are the least likely to be blocked.
apifyProxyGroups.title: Apify Proxy Groups

proxyUrls.description: List of custom proxy URLs to be used instead of the Apify Proxy.
proxyUrls.title: Proxy URLs

useApifyProxy.description: Whether to use Apify Proxy. Set this to false when you want to use custom proxy URLs.
useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy

respectRobotsTxt.description:
Skip pages that a site's robots.txt asks crawlers not to visit.
Example values: true
respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt

startUrls.description:
**REQUIRED** Websites or domains to extract contacts from, one per line. Examples: https://www.example.com or example.com. Each site becomes exactly one output row.
Example values: ["https://apify.com","https://www.python.org"]

items.description: **REQUIRED** Websites or domains to extract contacts from, one per line. Examples: https://www.example.com or example.com. Each site becomes exactly one output row.
items.title: Websites

startUrls.title: Websites
